title: hive daemon status output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive daemon status --json`. Reports whether the dispatcher daemon is running, its PID, and uptime. Exit code is 0 when running, 1 when not.

running.description: Whether a live, ownership-verified daemon process holds the PID file.

pid.description: PID of the running daemon, or null when running=false.

uptime_sec.description: Seconds since the PID file was written (mtime), or null when running=false.

pid_file.description: Absolute path of the PID file the daemon writes to.

log_file.description: Absolute path of the daemon's JSON-line log file.

service_installed.description: Whether the per-user autostart unit file exists on disk (non-mutating probe). Always present; null only if the probe itself could not run.

service_enabled.description: Whether the service manager reports the autostart unit as enabled/loaded (non-mutating probe). Always present; null only if the probe itself could not run.

unit_path.description: Absolute path of the autostart unit file; null on unsupported platforms or if the probe could not run.

installed_binary.description: Path to the hive binary the installed autostart unit invokes; null when no unit is installed or the probe could not run.

expected_binary.description: Path to the hive binary an install/repair would write into the unit (the resolved current binary); null if the probe could not run.

installed_binary_version.description: Version string reported by `installed_binary --version`; null when unreadable, the probe timed out, or no unit is installed.

cli_version.description: The version of the hive binary that produced this envelope (same as current_version).

binary_drift.description: Whether the installed unit's binary diverges from the current one: none (matches), path (different binary path), version (same path, older version), unparseable (unit present but its binary could not be read), not_applicable (no unit installed / probe could not run).

current_version.description: The running hive version, so a caller can compare against update_nudge.latest itself.

update_nudge.description: Available-update nudge written by the daemon, or null when up to date / unknown.

command.description: Exact command to update on this channel.

job_store_resets.description: Read-only per-project Architecture Patrol JobStore generation status. Released v2 jobs require an explicit archived reset and are never converted.
